title: Existence and singularity formation for the supersonic expanding wave of radially symmetric non-isentropic compressible Euler equations
summary: This paper studies the existence and singularity formation of supersonic expanding waves for the radially symmetric non-isentropic compressible Euler equations of polytropic gases. We introduce a suitable pair of gradient variables to characterize the rarefaction and compression properties of the solutions. Based on their Riccati equations, we construct several useful invariant domains to establish a series of priori estimates of solutions under some assumptions on the initial data.
